<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    return {n['id']:(n['color'],n['pixels']) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']}
probes=[('charcoal',15,5),('graytop',20,25),('yellow',20,24),('darkred',31,19),('graybot',41,11),('greenblk',41,12)]
for name,r,c in probes:
    before=snap()
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after=snap()
    changed = before!=after
    # find what changed
    diffs=[]
    for k in set(before)|set(after):
        if before.get(k)!=after.get(k): diffs.append((k,before.get(k),after.get(k)))
    print(name,(r,c),"changed=",changed, diffs[:6])
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("DONE!"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
